falsifiable_claim: Under a session naming a bounded connection: N in-envelope invokes return 200 with no challenge and a hypervisor.session.standing_draw receipt each while the wallet consumes exactly N usages; org_policy.exact_review_tools marks a tool → 202 exact_effect_review_required with the daemon's policy/request commitments and a durable hypervisor.session.exact_effect_review receipt, no draw, and a bogus exact grant refuses at the exact lane; draw N+1 → 403 standing_envelope_exceeded / refused_bound max_usages / widening_path /__ioi/connections with a hypervisor.session.standing_refusal receipt, identically on a second direct probe; a tool outside the template refuses before any wallet call; a session-less invoke keeps the exact challenge; the execute gate draws a run's execution against a covering lease (silent) or fails closed typed (alpha journey, fixture mode).
adversarial_or_fault_proof: ACC-15 §4 mutation: marking the act interactive_exact_effect in the admitted policy turns silence into the review (and back); ACC-18 bypass drills: the standing lease, a bogus exact grant and the same bytes twice never admit a review-marked tool and consume nothing; ACC-15 §5: the same probe twice refuses identically (UI bypass); all on the real fixture, 24/24.

The review expiry (15 minutes) is recorded on the object but not yet enforced by a sweeper; an exact grant is bound to the request hash regardless.
